evidence: issues/PROD-4498.json: 25-35s 502 windows, no deploys, upstream timeouts
runbooks/auth-502-windows.md: root cause 95% of the time

recommended_action: Confirm db_pool_idle is 0 during a window, then bump DB_POOL_SIZE from 30 to 60. Don't scale up auth-service pods and don't increase the load balancer timeout. Long term: argon2id (PROD-4221).
